evals.prompt: Проведи Nyquist-аудит покрытия требований платежного API. Ничего не изменяй. Все текущие тесты зелёные: достаточно ли их?
evals.expected_output: Distinguishes status-only tests from durable idempotency; finds missing concurrency evidence and skipped test; audit changes nothing.
assertions: Does not accept HTTP-only checks or skipped tests as verified idempotency
Maps requirement to observable durable effect and exact runnable command
Reports unresolved concurrency coverage and limits

evals.prompt: Закрой тестами пробелы Nyquist-валидации последовательных повторов платежа по REQ-PAY-1. Сохрани VALIDATION.md. Работай только с последовательными запросами.
evals.expected_output: Adds and runs a durable-effect assertion, exposes duplicate records, escalates without changing implementation.
assertions: Creates and executes a behavioral test of persisted operation count
Reports the duplicate-payment implementation defect and does not weaken the test
VALIDATION.md retains noncompliance with reproducible failing evidence

evals.prompt: Спланируй Nyquist-валидацию этой фичи до реализации. Сохрани VALIDATION.md, не устанавливай зависимости.
evals.expected_output: Standalone strategy with requirement IDs, invariants, observables and scaffolding, no false passing claims.
assertions: Works without a specification framework and without installing dependencies
Defines distinct authorization, atomicity and retry obligations
Provides proposed commands and clearly marks missing scaffolding

evals.prompt: Закрой пробелы тестами для OpenSpec change owner-only-delete и сохрани отчёт в его VALIDATION.md. Учитывай все requirement/scenario этого изменения. Не меняй реализацию и спецификации.
evals.expected_output: Uses modified contract rather than baseline/archive, preserves renamed identity, exposes member deletion defect despite checked tasks, saves noncompliant report without source/spec edits.
assertions: Uses owner-only MODIFIED contract and flags Member denied as failing, despite baseline/archive allowing members
Tracks Read document to View document rename without counting two requirements
Creates and executes meaningful tests; checked tasks and existing green tests do not count as complete coverage
Implementation and all OpenSpec input artifacts remain byte-identical; only tests and requested report change
Saves change VALIDATION.md with coverage_complete false and reproducible defect evidence
